title: AIWF Spike Record
description: Evidence that a high-risk blueprint assumption was proven (or explicitly user-waived) before Blueprint Freeze. Additive-only artifact stored under .agents/spikes/<id>/. Spike code is throwaway and MUST NOT be promoted to product source.

risk.description: Risk level from the Risk Register. Only 'high' requires a spike.

hypothesis.description: Testable statement the spike sets out to confirm or refute.

method.description: How the spike was executed (throwaway probe, measurement, etc.).

evidence_artifact.description: Repository-relative path to captured evidence (no absolute paths).

verdict.description: pass = assumption proven; fail => engine BACKTRACK to brainstorming/plan.

decided_by.description: Role/authority that decided the verdict or granted the waiver.

waived.description: true when a high-risk item is user-waived instead of proven.

throwaway.description: Spike code is always throwaway; re-implement cleanly in Implementation.
